sb_prompt: WHAT HOBBIES DO YOU HAVE IN YOUR SPARE TIME?  DO THEY INCLUDE ANY HANDICRAFTSWOODWORKING?
raw_output:
ParticipantA: Hello!
ParticipantB: Hello!
ParticipantB: Yeah, hi. Who is this?
ParticipantA: It's me, the one who called you about the hobby exchange.
ParticipantB: Oh, right! Sorry, I was just grabbing a coffee. I'm Sarah, by the way.
ParticipantA: Nice to meet you, I'm Elena. So, do you have any hobbies in your spare time?
ParticipantB: Well, yeah, actually. I work at the pharmacy downtown, so I'm pretty decent at first aid and organizing meds.
ParticipantB: And I dabble in sewing sometimes. It's a little relaxing.
ParticipantA: Oh, really? That's nice. I actually have a degree in library science, so books are my main thing.
ParticipantA: I read all the time and I sort of like organizing things. But I don't do any woodworking or crafts like that.
ParticipantB: Oh, interesting. Do you just read, or do you like making things too?
ParticipantA: Mostly just reading. I've been into it for years, honestly. Just never figured out why exactly, but I love it.
ParticipantB: Yeah, some people are like that. I guess it's just about the quiet time.
ParticipantB: But honestly, I'm mixed on the whole "craft" thing. I like sewing for clothes, but I can't stand the idea of building furniture.
ParticipantB: It feels too messy for me.
ParticipantA: Oh, totally. I get that. I actually know a guy who got into woodworking and he quit after a year.
ParticipantB: Really? Why'd he quit?
ParticipantA: He said it was just too loud and dusty. Said he didn't want his nice apartment covered in sawdust.
ParticipantB: That makes sense. My cousin actually tried it once. He was so into it at first.
ParticipantB: But then he said it got really stressful, like he felt like he was working an extra job on weekends.
ParticipantB: Now he just buys stuff instead of making it.
ParticipantA: That's a shame. I guess everyone has their limit. I think I'll stick to books for a while longer.
ParticipantB: Yeah, no rush. It's good to just find what works for you.
ParticipantA: Exactly. It's nice to just relax without the mess.
ParticipantB: Definitely. Well, I'm gonna head back to the pharmacy if you aren't busy.
ParticipantA: No, I'm free. It was nice talking to you, Sarah.
ParticipantB: You too, Elena. Good luck with the reading!
ParticipantA: Thanks, you too! Bye.
ParticipantB: Bye.
